closure: All 48 optimizer trajectories selected/stopped and all30 bank exports/57 physical backbone states close before any CAL truth release. All30 fixed CAL endpoints close before a single complete DEVELOPMENT_EVAL release. No subset/arm/block outcome chooses a continuation. I4 independent selected states all required; joint banks restore one complete synchronized selected state. No historical TEST archive, truth, prediction arrays or model states reused.
bank_exports: CAL and DEVELOPMENT_EVAL ids, member log probabilities and pre-readout native member/pool argmax; no truth. Full selected-state receipt, all RNG/optimizer/costs. Root owns safe provider/scorer and source admission.
calibration: One scalar temperature shared across members per bank: p_T=mean_m softmax(member_log_probability_m/T); float64 CAL NLL. Optimize logT from0 by Adam LR.05,500 steps,beta.9/.999,eps1e-8,clamp logT [-5,5]; select latest tied minimum CAL NLL among step0..500, then freeze. No per-member temperatures or shared temperature across banks. Report raw and calibrated accuracy,NLL,Brier; raw accuracy is primary.
primary: raw native arithmetic mean of member probabilities; calibrated accuracy separately reported
